title: Cheqaqpa Trono
intro: Huk atiyniyoq kamachikuqmi, ancha yachayniyoq kayninwan, hatun kamachikuy tiyananwan reqsisqa, mana reqsisqa willakuytan chaskikun. Kay mana suyasqa rimanakuymi iñiyninkuta, kamachikuyninkuta ima sasachan, chaymi huk diplomático puriyman churan, chaymi yuyayninkuta pruebanqa, qhepamantaq espiritualpi ukhu rikch’ariyman apakunqa. ¿Atiwaqchu kay kamachikuqpa pi kayninta, tukuy reinonkuta tikraq sucesokunamantapas?
clues: Llaqtaywanmi intita yupaychaq kayku, ñawpa taytaykupa ñanninta qatispa.
Huk pisqu, huk hoopoe, mana yuyasqa willakuqmi karqan, chaymi huk atiyniyoq umalliqpa cartanta apamuwarqan.
Kachaqpa yachayninta pruebanaypaqmi ancha valorniyoq regalokunata apachirqani, ichaqa kutichipuwarqankun, kachaq runaqa aswan hatun qhapaq kaytan chaskirqan Allahmanta.
Manaraq kachaqpa palacionmanpas chayashaqtiymi, huk ñawi ch’ipiyllapi sumaq kamachikuyniyta milagrota hina chayman aparqanku.
Chayaspaymi tapuwarqaku chay apasqa trono ñuqapachu icha manachu, hinaptinmi kutichirqani: ‘Chay tronopas kanman hinam’, nispa.
Huk hatun salamanmi haykurqani huk pampata pantarqani yaku quchawan, chay manchakuy ratopim, profeta Sulaimanpa waqtanpi Allahman, kay pachakunapa Señorninman, entregakurqani.

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
